article.simpara: Some simple caching tools implementing PSR-6 and PSR-16.

section.title: Goals
section.simpara: There is a lot to cover here so best I keep a bit of a record so as not to let bits fall between the cracks. As a bonus, a record will help keep me focused on the goal as well as track progress. Man can I talk/type crap oir what?

section.title: Primary Goal
section.simpara: To reduce remote access when using internet or other non-local sourced data.

section.title: Example
section.simpara: Basic example, creating a RemoteFileCache object and using it to only return a file once. Using the defaults any subsequent requests, within a one day period for the same url, retrieves content from cache.

"No way!", I hear you say. "That is so simple!" Yes, it is. But it is also very powerful. The RemoteFileCache class implements the PSR-6 and PSR-16 interfaces so you can use it with any other library that implements those interfaces. It also has a few extra features that make it even more useful.
